remarks: Location! Location! Location!. Quiet remodeled 2 bedrooms, 1.5-bath contemporary ranch apartment within walking distance to downtown, library, train station, and parks. The spacious living room has a fireplace and built-in bookshelves; both bedrooms have large closets. Eat-in kitchen with a gas oven. On-site, laundry and storage space. Enjoy the outdoors with a patio partially fenced and flat park-like ground. Gas/heat, water, driveway snow removal, and regular yard maintenance are included !!
